title: Unify Bureau ready selection and live claims
goal: Connect deterministic ready eligibility, live thread focus, atomic claims, Grabowski resource leases, repository and PR conflict checks, isolated worktrees and durable closeout receipts into one collision-safe task pickup path.

acceptance.assertion: Task pickup requires registry state ready, satisfied dependencies, valid queue placement, no terminal state and no hard PR, task, repository or resource conflict.
The pickup path atomically records a live claim and acquires required Grabowski resource leases, or fails without leaving a partial claim.
Claim, heartbeat and release state remain outside Git and do not require a Bureau PR, while durable task definition, promotion and completion evidence remain reviewable registry truth.
A claimed repository mutation task receives one isolated worktree and any working PR binds exactly one valid task; ambiguous or conflicting states fail closed.
Expired or lost claims reconcile without duplicate execution, and successful closeout writes typed evidence, releases leases and removes terminal tasks from active lanes.
Status projection distinguishes no eligible work, eligible unclaimed work, claimed work and blocked work, so a low ready count is visible rather than silently treated as executor failure.

metadata.live_gap: The registry currently contains only one task in state ready despite many planned tasks; readiness, live focus and runtime leases are implemented in separate surfaces.

lease_scope_migration.rationale: Collision-safe pickup joins eligibility code, operational state, exact lease policy, worktree administration and task truth.
does_not_establish: safe mutation of terminal historical tasks

reprioritization.reason: Ready selection, live focus, atomic claims, Grabowski leases, conflict checks and durable closeout are already separate surfaces; their collision-safe pickup integration is now the highest-leverage next operator-convergence step.
does_not_establish: automatic queue mutation beyond this reviewed registry change

completion.outcome: The reviewed Bureau implementation, exact Grabowski hardening, successful production pilot, typed orphan reconciliation and deployed stable grip surface satisfy all T005 acceptance criteria.

verified_acceptance.eligibility-chain: Commit e61251c implements deterministic ready eligibility, dependency/queue/terminal checks and fail-closed task, PR, repository and resource conflict checks.
verified_acceptance.atomic-claim-and-lease: The T015 production pilot proved no partial real-owner lease after conflict and exactly one run plus one owner-bound lease after success.
verified_acceptance.gitless-transient-state: Claims, heartbeats, envelopes and release state remain in the external Bureau SQLite/state root; reviewed task definitions and closeout evidence remain in Git.
verified_acceptance.worktree-and-pr-binding: The implementation binds task, plan, runtime, source head, workspace and working PR identity; conflicting or ambiguous states are covered by fail-closed tests.
verified_acceptance.recovery-and-closeout: T016 closes root/compensation ambiguity, T015 proves terminalization and idempotent own-lease release, and the old orphaned run was reconciled through the typed release grip.
verified_acceptance.ready-supply-visible: The v2 status projection exposes ready_supply and differentiates eligible unclaimed, claimed, blocked and no-eligible-work states.

metadata.verification_note: T005 verifies the collision-safe pickup path and visible ready supply. It does not authorize automatic dispatch, foreign mutation or bypass of PR and lease guards.
